beats.text: Across India, masks do more than hide a face. They carry deities, guardians, animals, heroes, and stories into motion.
Some masks arrive with martial force. Some protect the village. Some teach the victory of good over evil. Some burn bright with fierce devotion.
Your answers will choose one mask from four traditions: Somana Kunitha, Chau, Bardo Chham, and Gomira.
Step into the frame. Let the rhythm find the face it belongs to.
